ns2:course.label: Natural Language Processing
ns2:course.description: Part-of-speech tagging, parsing, semantic analysis and machine translation. Relevant linguistics concepts from morphology (word formation) and lexical semantics (the meaning of words) to syntax (sentence structure) and compositional semantics (the meaning of sentences). 3 undergraduate hours. 3 or 4 graduate hours. Prerequisite: One of CS 173 or MATH 213; CS 225; CS 374 or ECE 374; one of CS 361, STAT 361, ECE 313, MATH 362, MATH 461, MATH 463, STAT 400 or BIOE 310; one of MATH 225, MATH 257, MATH 415, MATH 416, ASRM 406 or BIOE 210.
